timing.startRule: effectivePeriod.start is the first frame instant
timing.periodRule: period is strictly greater than zero
timing.dimensionsRule: dimensions is a strictly positive integer and data token count is divisible by dimensions
timing.frameCountRule: frameCount = decimal data token count / dimensions and is at least 2

contracts.phdProfileApplicability: only when the source exchange independently satisfies the IEEE 11073 PHD/PHG workflow

integrity.hashAlgorithm: FHIR R4 Attachment.hash SHA-1 encoded as base64
integrity.embeddedRule: size and hash match the decoded attachment.data bytes
integrity.urlRule: attachment.url is immutable and version-specific; changed bytes require a new URL and business identity
integrity.securityRule: Attachment.hash is change detection only, never a signature, authorization decision, or security credential

payloadAdmission.requiredProducerInput: exactly one explicit caller assertion before emission
payloadAdmission.failureRule: Absent, ambiguous, or unsupported assertions fail closed before creating a DocumentReference.
payloadAdmission.scope: This producer preflight is not encoded as a FHIR authorization or consent claim. The IG does not inspect, fetch, or sanitize opaque attachment bytes.

contracts.rule: Every transformation graph identifies the assembler application and at least one complete source entity Identifier; raw and structured outputs use the same auditable graph shape.
